regular.name: clean-war-camp
regular.prompt: Edit the reference into a CLEAN, restrained fantasy newspaper background. Preserve portrait 3:4 and all blank text areas at exactly the same positions and sizes. NO text or numbers anywhere. Replace the entire ornate decoration, gryphons, castles, banners and heavy sepia texture with pale ivory lightly fibrous paper and thin charcoal rules. Remove box outlines: retain only thin horizontal section rules and two delicate vertical rules dividing the bottom thirds. Leave the masthead/top third completely blank apart from one tiny muted red Horde-style emblem in the far upper-left margin. Blank headline, left article and bottom three columns stay pristine and pale. Keep a modest sparse black pen-and-ink fantasy vignette ONLY inside the existing right-middle illustration rectangle; ample whitespace, restrained engraving with believable hand-drawn linework. Subtle slight wear at two corners, tiny scorch mark only on outer edge, no heavy burns. Bottom decorative scene replaced by a small simple ink vignette near bottom-right below all text areas, rest blank. No towers, heraldic animals, elaborate filigree, detailed background scenery, crowded character art, 3D rendering, dramatic lighting, muddy stains or oversized symbols. Quiet real newspaper composition with fantasy hints. Flat full-bleed paper, not a framed poster. Right-middle vignette: an orc peon sitting on a wooden crate, reading a folded paper, a small spiked shield against the crate. Sparse ink illustration. Tiny bottom-right: an axe and boots.

welcome: Create a finished, restrained fantasy guild newspaper welcome cover. Portrait 3:4. CLEAN editorial design, authentic typeset page, plentiful whitespace, quiet and readable. Warm pale ivory paper with very subtle fine fiber texture; only a tiny singed corner. Dark charcoal ink, one muted oxblood red accent rule. Broad 7% margins. Balanced classical serif typography resembling Caslon/Baskerville, crisp even typesetting, NOT distressed display lettering, NOT Western poster lettering, NOT massive all-caps headlines. Fantasy-coded through ONE understated small Horde-style emblem above masthead and ONE modest black ink woodcut vignette in the middle: a simple friendly orc peon reading a newspaper, tauren holding a mug, troll fishing, in sparse hand-drawn linework with lots of blank paper around them. No detailed city backdrop. Exact copy, with clean hierarchy: masthead 'Original Formalities' and smaller 'Weekly'; headline on two lines 'First issue' and 'coming Monday'; subtitle 'Guild news. Questionable decisions.'; beneath the vignette 'Big drops. Bad landings. Names will be named.'; bottom smaller sign-off 'Play this week. Read all about it next week.' Preserve all these words exactly, no additional copy. Simple thin horizontal rules only, no boxed text panels. The illustration occupies about one third of page height. Polished understated newspaper, NOT an ornate fantasy poster. Absolutely no towers, wolves in corners, banner garlands, spike borders, elaborate filigree, weapons piles, dramatic lighting, over-rendered characters, muddy textures or heavy burns. Flat full-bleed paper artwork only. Keep top-right corner clear for an in-game close button.
textureEdit: Change ONLY the paper material in this finished newspaper cover. Preserve every word, letter, font, layout, illustration, emblem, red rule and ink stroke exactly. The clean editorial design is approved. Give the paper a more visible old parchment texture: warmer honey-ivory tone, visible fine paper fibers, soft irregular mottling, a few faint fold creases and lightly rubbed darker edges. Paper should feel tangible and aged, noticeably less plain white. Keep the center light with excellent black-text contrast. No new ornament or illustration, no new stains over letters, no heavy grunge, no distressed lettering, no additional burn marks. Keep all exact copy and clean composition.
